cues.title: 先找证据，再给硫定位
cues.caption: 不同现象，怎样连成同一张硫的转化图？
cues.captionEn: How do different observations connect on one sulfur map?
cues.zh: 黄色分散物、使品红褪色的气体、撤去热源后仍前进的红热带，为什么都能放进同一张图？先认出证据，再追踪硫。负二、零、正四和正六价，是电子归属的记账。换反应伙伴，硫可能给出电子，也可能接收；图上的箭头要由具体反应来支撑。
cues.en: A yellow dispersion, gas that fades fuchsin, and a glow that travels after the heater is removed: how do these belong on one map? Start with the evidence, then follow sulfur. Minus two, zero, plus four and plus six are electron-accounting states. A different partner can make sulfur give up electrons or receive them. Every arrow needs a reaction behind it.

cues.title: 三个硫，电子怎样对上账？
cues.caption: 两个低价硫给出的份额，由同一个高价硫接收。
cues.captionEn: Two donors supply the electron units received by one sulfur.
cues.zh: 先看硫化物与亚硫酸对应的生成硫路线。这里只展开三个硫的净账：两个负二价的硫各给出两份电子，一个正四价的硫接收四份。三个硫都有自己的标记，最后都记为零价，没有一个硫从画面外补进来。胶囊表示电子份额，不是溶液中飞行的自由电子。
cues.en: Consider the sulfur-forming route associated with sulfide and sulfurous acid. Focus on its three sulfur centres. Each of the two at minus two gives up two electron units; the centre at plus four receives all four. Keep their identities: the same three sulfurs finish at zero. No extra sulfur appears. The capsules represent an electron account, not free electrons flying through the solution.

cues.title: 褪色相同，转化上限也相同吗？
cues.titleEn: The same fading, the same conversion limit?
cues.caption: 先确定净反应终点，才能计算电子需求。
cues.captionEn: The assumed endpoint determines the electron demand.
cues.zh: 酸性高锰酸钾的紫色消退，说明它被消耗，却不能替硫选定终点。假设锰最后是正二价，两份高锰酸根接收十份电子。先猜：这够转化同样多的硫化物吗？到单质硫，每个硫给出两份，最多转化五份；到硫酸根，每个给出八份，最多只有一点二五份。这是两条净账假设，不是颜色给出的产物分析。
cues.en: Fading purple shows permanganate being consumed, but does not select sulfur’s endpoint. Assume manganese ends at plus two: two permanganates accept ten electron units. Predict whether that budget converts the same amount of sulfide. Reaching elemental sulfur supplies two units per sulfur, allowing five. Reaching sulfate supplies eight per sulfur, allowing only one point two five. These are alternative net balances, not products identified from colour.

cues.title: 沿导管追踪生成气体
cues.titleEn: Trace the product gas through the tube
cues.caption: 铜与热浓硫酸反应，气体通入品红后使其褪色。
cues.captionEn: Copper reacts with hot concentrated acid; the product gas fades fuchsin.
cues.zh: 沿着导管看气体的去向。铜与热浓硫酸反应，生成的二氧化硫进入品红溶液，使颜色褪去。编号实验使用可提起的螺旋铜丝，章末活动使用铜片；教学入口会保留这个差别。这个反应的气体不是氢气：硫酸中的硫从正六价被还原到正四价。
cues.en: Follow the connected gas path. Copper reacts with hot concentrated sulfuric acid, producing sulfur dioxide that fades fuchsin. The numbered experiment uses a liftable copper coil; the chapter activity uses a copper piece, and its entry preserves that distinction. The gas is not hydrogen: sulfur is reduced from plus six to plus four.

cues.title: 结束反应，保留观察对象
cues.titleEn: End the reaction and preserve the sample
cues.caption: 结束反应后，先让反应体系冷却。
cues.captionEn: End the reaction and let the system cool.
cues.zh: 生成气体的过程结束了，先保留反应后的样品并让它冷却。编号实验可以把铜丝提出液面来停止新增反应，章末铜片装置则显示停止加热后的状态。提起铜丝不会让已经形成的产物倒退消失。后续观察针对的是同一反应所得物。
cues.en: Gas production ends and the reaction sample is kept to cool. In the numbered experiment the wire lifts out of the liquid; the chapter activity instead shows the copper-piece apparatus after heating stops. Lifting the wire does not erase products already formed. The next observation follows the same reaction material.

cues.title: 两个硫，为什么走向两处？
cues.titleEn: Why do two sulfurs take different destinations?
cues.caption: 同一净反应中，一个硫留在盐里，一个进入气体。
cues.captionEn: One sulfur stays in sulfate; the other enters the gas.
cues.zh: 冷却所得物进入水中，蓝色为溶液中的铜离子补上证据。跟住两份硫酸里的两个硫：A留在硫酸盐中，仍是正六价；B进入二氧化硫，降到正四价。其余氧和氢配成两份水。假如只有一份硫酸和一份铜，铜还能全部反应吗？按这个净反应，最多转化半份铜；多放铜也补不上缺少的酸。活动入口借用的是前文编号实验的溶液证据。
cues.en: Adding the cooled material to water gives blue solution, supporting the presence of dissolved copper ions. Follow two sulfurs from the acid. The first sulfur stays in sulfate at plus six. The second sulfur enters sulfur dioxide at plus four. The remaining oxygen and hydrogen make two waters. With only one acid unit and one copper unit, can all the copper react? This net equation allows only half a copper unit. More copper cannot replace missing acid. The activity entry borrows the earlier numbered experiment’s solution evidence.

cues.title: 只点热粉末条的一端
cues.titleEn: Heat one end of the powder strip
cues.caption: 局部热源让一小段铁硫混合物开始反应。
cues.captionEn: A local heat source starts reaction in a small part of the iron–sulfur mixture.
cues.zh: 把视线转到陶土网上的铁硫粉末条。灼热玻璃棒只接触一端，最先变红的是靠近接触点的一小段。模型没有把整条粉末同时点亮：局部温度达到反应阈值后，反应才释放热量。玻璃棒随后移开，接下来要看反应是否还能继续。
cues.en: Move to the iron–sulfur powder strip on the ceramic support. A hot glass rod contacts one end, so only a small nearby region first glows. The whole strip is not switched on at once: local heating starts a reaction that releases more heat. The rod is then removed, letting us test whether the reaction continues.

cues.title: 移开热源，红热带继续前进
cues.titleEn: The glowing front continues without the rod
cues.caption: 放热与热传递推动反应前沿，反应后的区域逐渐冷却。
cues.captionEn: Released heat and heat transfer sustain the front; reacted regions cool.
cues.zh: 外部热源已经移开，红热带仍向未反应区域传播。反应释放的热量传给相邻粉末，触发下一段反应；后方的物质逐渐冷却变暗。铁被氧化，硫被还原，理想主反应生成硫化亚铁。传播速度与颜色只是无量纲模型的表达，不是测得的温度曲线。
cues.en: The external heater is gone, yet the glowing front moves into unreacted powder. Released heat reaches neighbouring material and triggers further reaction, while the material behind cools and darkens. Iron is oxidized and sulfur reduced in the ideal main reaction forming iron-two sulfide. Front speed and glow are dimensionless model outputs, not measured temperatures.

cues.title: 黑色产物一定纯吗？
cues.titleEn: Does a black product have to be pure?
cues.caption: 先用初始量预测剩余物，再看颜色的限度。
cues.captionEn: Use initial amounts to predict what remains.
cues.zh: 按教材的起始质量，铁比主反应所需的量略多。先猜：变黑之后一定只剩硫化亚铁吗？理想主反应算得约一点三七克硫化亚铁，还留下约零点一三克铁；总质量仍是原来的一点五克。这还没有算空气：铁或硫也可能与氧气反应。颜色不能代替成分分析，净账的结论必须带着反应条件一起使用。
cues.en: The textbook’s starting masses contain slightly more iron than the main reaction needs. Predict: must the black product contain only iron sulfide? The ideal balance gives about one point three seven grams of iron sulfide and leaves zero point one three grams of iron. Together they retain the original one point five grams. This excludes air reactions: iron or sulfur can also react with oxygen. Colour cannot replace composition analysis, and a net balance must retain its conditions.

label.en: Copper reacting with concentrated sulfuric acid

label.zh: 不同价态含硫物质的转化
不同价态含硫物质的转化

question.zh: 两份硫酸中的硫，都变成气体了吗？
question.en: Do both sulfurs from the acid become gas?

lead.zh: 沿品红褪色与蓝色溶液两条证据，追踪同一批铜、硫、氧和氢。
lead.en: Follow fuchsin fading and blue solution, then track the same copper, sulfur, oxygen and hydrogen.

principle.zh: 铜给出的两份电子只对应一个硫由+6降到+4；另一硫仍以+6留在硫酸盐中。Cu+2H₂SO₄→CuSO₄+SO₂+2H₂O的原子与电子净账共同限制转化量。
principle.en: Two electron units from copper reduce one sulfur from +6 to +4. The other sulfur stays at +6 in sulfate. Both atom and electron balances constrain Cu + 2H₂SO₄ → CuSO₄ + SO₂ + 2H₂O.

question.zh: 一份硫酸和一份铜，在所选净反应中最多能转化多少铜？
question.en: With one acid unit and one copper unit, how much copper can this net reaction convert?

explanation.zh: 最多半份铜，留下半份铜。每份铜需要两份硫酸；这里只给净组成的物质的量上限，不从时间或颜色推算真实产率。
explanation.en: At most half a copper unit, leaving half. Each copper requires two acids. This is a net amount limit, not a yield inferred from time or colour.

question.zh: 换一个反应伙伴，硫为什么会走向不同价态？
question.en: Why does another partner send sulfur to a different oxidation state?

lead.zh: 从各条反应的证据进入硫与电子账，再比较相同氧化剂份额能支持的不同净终点。
lead.en: Move from reaction evidence to sulfur and electron accounts, then compare endpoints supported by the same oxidant budget.

principle.zh: 反应双方给出和接收的电子份额必须相等。硫可被氧化或还原，但价态箭头不单独决定真实路径；物料、酸度与其他条件仍须核查。
principle.en: Electron units given and received must balance. Sulfur can be oxidized or reduced, but oxidation-state arrows do not determine the actual pathway; matter, acidity and other conditions still matter.

question.zh: 两份高锰酸根都降到Mn²⁺，能把同样多的硫化物分别转到S或SO₄²⁻吗？
question.en: If two permanganates become Mn²⁺, can they convert equal amounts of sulfide into S and SO₄²⁻?

explanation.zh: 不能。酸性、质子充分的两条假设净路线中，每个硫分别给2或8份电子；同样10份电子的接收能力对应5或1.25份硫。此比较不能据褪色宣布唯一产物。
explanation.en: No. Under the two assumed acidic routes with sufficient protons, each sulfur gives two or eight electron units. The same ten-unit capacity corresponds to five or 1.25 sulfurs. Fading does not establish a unique product.

question.zh: 相似的变色，能说明同一种转化吗？
question.en: Does a similar colour change establish the same transformation?

lead.zh: 逐个比较硫化物、铜片与浓硫酸、铁硫粉末的证据，每一段都接回电子或物料账。
lead.en: Compare sulfide, copper with concentrated acid, and iron–sulfur evidence, connecting each to electron or matter balances.

principle.zh: 不同伙伴改变硫的电子收支；铁硫局部放热能通过热传递推动前沿，主反应量仍受初始物料限制。颜色只作定性证据，不能证明绝对纯净。
principle.en: Partners change sulfur’s electron balance. Local iron–sulfur heat release can sustain a travelling front, while initial amounts limit the main reaction. Colour is qualitative evidence, not proof of purity.

question.zh: 教材配比反应后变黑，为什么仍不能称为纯FeS？
question.en: Why does the textbook mixture turning black not establish pure FeS?

explanation.zh: 按Fe+S→FeS的理想主反应，1.0g铁与0.5g硫约形成1.371g FeS并余0.129g铁；空气还可能带来氧化副反应。这个净账不是实际产物分析。
explanation.en: The ideal Fe + S → FeS balance converts 1.0 g Fe and 0.5 g S into about 1.371 g FeS plus 0.129 g excess Fe. Air can add oxidation reactions. This balance is not an analysis of the actual product.

translations.选定反应的现象示意，颜色不表示浓度: Qualitative appearance of a selected pathway; colour is not concentration
translations.净电子账 · 不是微观轨迹: Net electron account · not a microscopic path
translations.持久的反应中心与两电子份额: Persistent reaction centres and two-electron packets
translations.反应管与品红管由同一条导气管连接: One connected gas tube joins the reaction and fuchsin vessels
translations.同一所得物，冷却后观察: The same material, observed after cooling
translations.冷却所得物进入原有水中，出现蓝色溶液: Cooled reaction material enters existing water and gives a blue solution
translations.同一批铜、硫、氧、氢的净分配: Net allocation of the same copper, sulfur, oxygen and hydrogen atoms
translations.相同氧化剂份额，不同转化上限: Same oxidant budget, different upper limits
translations.能转化同样多的硫化物吗？: Can both convert the same amount of sulfide?
translations.2份酸，才配齐1份铜的净反应: The net equation needs 2 acid units per Cu
translations.邻域热传递和局部反应生成的红热前沿: A glowing front from local reaction and neighbouring heat transfer
translations.理想主反应的净量，不是产物分析: Ideal main-reaction amounts, not an analysis
translations.颜色是定性现象，不换算浓度。电子胶囊、原子移动和组成框表示选定净反应的守恒账，不: Colours are qualitative, not concentration readings. Electron packets, moving atoms and composition groups express a selected net balance, not solvated electrons, isolated salt molecules or a stepwise mechanism. Sulfide acid–base speciation and intermediate products are not resolved. The two permanganate routes separately assume acidic conditions and Mn²⁺; controls do not predict a unique product. Heat propagation is dimensionless, and air side reactions are not computed.
